architecture.mechanism: in situ correlative imaging of X-ray Compton scattering computed tomography to map lithium-ion concentration in 3D structures
architecture.intervention: Apply XCS-CT analysis to failed Jeep battery cells to identify internal microstructural defects or electrolyte depletion zones causing severe discharge.
architecture.expected_effect: Precise localization of chemical composition changes and structural failures within the battery to guide targeted manufacturing corrections or material substitutions.
architecture.falsification_test: Perform XCS-CT on a known good production battery cell; if the scan reveals significant lithium concentration gradients or voids similar to the failed unit, the mechanism is falsified as a root cause indicator.
